285714764.description:
Pressed Glass Insulator Lot - 2 Pieces
Armstrong & Whitall Tatum
Clear, Mid-20th Century
This pair of vintage pressed glass insulators represents classic American communications infrastructure from the mid-20th century. Manufactured in Millville, New Jersey, these heavy-duty threaded pin-type glass units were engineered to insulate telephone and telegraph crossarm lines against weather and electrical grounding.
Pieces Included:
Armstrong's DP 1 glass insulator, clear with faint straw tint, corrugated drip point base, embossed "ARMSTRONG'S DP 1" and "MADE IN U.S.A. 42", 4 in height - structurally sound
Whitall Tatum No. 1 glass insulator, clear with smooth base, embossed "WHITALL TATUM No 1" and "MADE IN U.S.A. 45-44" with Circle A mark, 4 in height - structurally sound
Condition:
Both insulators remain in very good vintage condition with intact inner threading and legible embossed markings. Minor surface scuffs, tiny fleabites, and light residue consistent with authentic outdoor pole service. No major chips, large fractures, or structural cracks.
